## `ApplicationImpl`

[source](app.aug#L8)

Behavioral class.

Satisfies [`Application`](app.aug.md#symbol-Application).

**Author documentation**

Construction stores dependencies; start performs the visible external work.

**Inputs**

- `console` ([`Console`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console)) — injected; callers omit it — stored as `console` and read-only after initialization.

<a id="symbol-ApplicationImpl.start"></a>

### `ApplicationImpl.start`

[source](app.aug#L9)

Returns: no value.

Capabilities: [`console.write`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console.write).

**What it does**

- Set `fruit` to a list containing call [`Fruit`](models.aug.md#symbol-Fruit) with `code` = `1`; `name` = `"apple"`, call [`Fruit`](models.aug.md#symbol-Fruit) with `name` = `"pear"`; `code` = `2`.
- For each `item` in a snapshot of `fruit`, in iteration order:
  - Call [`Console.write`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console.write) on `console` with `value` = `name` of `item`.

**Author documentation**

Writes the fruit names through the selected console.
